# Load in all necessary packages
```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(sesame)
library(sesameData)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Query, Download, and Prepare the data.
```{r}
query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                  data.category = "DNA Methylation",
                  data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
                  platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450",
                  data.format = "Dataframe")

for (i in 1:30) {
  ok <- tryCatch({
    GDCdownload(query, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 20)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Attempt ", i, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    FALSE
  })
  if (ok) { message("Download complete!"); break }
  Sys.sleep(60)  # wait 1 minute, then retry
}

#methylation450 <- GDCprepare(query)
#saveRDS(methylation450, "methylation450.rds")
   # later:
methylation450 <- readRDS("methylation450.rds")
```
The above data requires a LOT of memory. My recommendation: GDCdownload() and GDCprepare() in separate R sessions.
R requires a lot of memory for both.

```{r}
methylation_clinical <- as.data.frame(methylation450@colData)
betas <- as.data.frame(methylation450@assays@data@listData) #takes a longer time
cpg_sites <- as.data.frame(methylation450@rowRanges@elementMetadata)

column_mask <- ifelse(colnames(methylation_clinical) %in% c('treatments', 'primary_site', 'disease_type','sites_of_involvement'), F, T)

methylation_clinical <- methylation_clinical[,column_mask]
write.csv(methylation_clinical, 'brca_methylation_clinical.csv')


site_mask <- !grepl('-', cpg_sites$gene) & !grepl(';', cpg_sites$gene) & !is.na(cpg_sites$gene) & complete.cases(betas)
betas <- betas[site_mask,]
cpg_sites <- cpg_sites[site_mask,]

write.csv(betas, 'brca_methylation_betas.csv') #takes a longer time
write.csv(cpg_sites, 'brca_cpg_sites.csv')
```

Use the code below if you are loading in your data (i.e. you downloaded the data and closed the session, but you are back to continue working)
```{r}
methylation_clinical <- read.csv('brca_methylation_clinical.csv', row.names = 1)
betas <- read.csv('brca_methylation_betas.csv', row.names=1)
cpg_sites <- read.csv('brca_cpg_sites.csv', row.names = 1)
```


# (1) Naive Differential Methylation
```{r}
# (1) Naive Differential Methylation
library(limma)

# keep only metastatic and primary tumor samples
keep <- methylation_clinical$definition %in% c("Metastatic", "Primary solid Tumor")
methylation_clinical <- methylation_clinical[keep, ]
betas_clean <- betas[, keep]

# TRUE = metastatic (comparison), FALSE = non-metastatic (base)
methylation_clinical$metastatic <- methylation_clinical$definition == "Metastatic"
table(methylation_clinical$metastatic)

mval <- t(apply(betas_clean, 1, function(x) log2(x / (1 - x))))

design <- model.matrix(~ metastatic, data = methylation_clinical)
fit <- lmFit(mval, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
```

```{r}
# Extracting model into dataframe
# Extract model into a dataframe and make the volcano plot
dat <- data.frame(foldchange = fit[["coefficients"]][, 2],
                  logPvalue = -log10(p.adjust(fit2[["p.value"]][, 2], method = "BY")),
                  geneName = cpg_sites$gene)
dat$threshold <- as.factor(abs(dat$foldchange) < 1)

cols <- c("TRUE" = "grey", "FALSE" = "blue")
ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = foldchange, y = logPvalue, colour = threshold)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .2, size = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "#990000", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, colour = "#990000", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), colour = "#990000", linetype = "dashed") +
  xlab("Fold Change (metastatic vs non-metastatic)") +
  ylab("-log10 adjusted p value") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

write.csv(dat, "methylation_results_metastatic.csv")
```

#(2) Direct comparison of methylation status to transcriptional activity
...INSERT DESeq2 Stuff here to generate 'results'...
```{r}
# (2) DESeq2: metastatic vs non-metastatic
if (!require("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
library(DESeq2)

rna_clinical <- read.csv("brca_rna_clinical_data.csv", row.names = 1)
rna_genes <- read.csv("brca_rna_gene_data.csv")
rna_counts <- read.csv("brca_rna_count_data.csv", row.names = 1)

# same two groups as the methylation analysis
keep_rna <- rna_clinical$definition %in% c("Metastatic", "Primary solid Tumor")
rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[keep_rna, ]
rna_counts <- rna_counts[, keep_rna]

rna_clinical$met_status <- factor(ifelse(rna_clinical$definition == "Metastatic",
                                         "metastatic", "non_metastatic"),
                                  levels = c("non_metastatic", "metastatic"))  # non-metastatic = base
table(rna_clinical$met_status)

# filter genes with total expression < 20
keep_genes <- rowSums(rna_counts) >= 20
rna_counts <- rna_counts[keep_genes, ]
rna_genes <- rna_genes[keep_genes, ]

colnames(rna_counts) <- rownames(rna_clinical)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(as.matrix(rna_counts)),
                              colData = rna_clinical,
                              design = ~ met_status)
dds_obj <- DESeq(dds)

results <- data.frame(results(dds_obj, contrast = c("met_status", "metastatic", "non_metastatic")))
results$gene_name <- rna_genes$gene_name
results$gene_id <- rna_genes$gene_id
write.csv(results, "deSeq_results_metastatic.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Genes that are downregulated (RNA) AND hypermethylated in metastatic samples
downregulated <- results[!is.na(results$padj) &
                           results$padj < 0.05 &
                           results$log2FoldChange < -1, "gene_name"]
hypermethylated <- dat[dat$logPvalue > -log10(0.05) &
                         dat$foldchange > 1, "geneName"]
interest_genes <- intersect(downregulated, hypermethylated)
interest_genes
```

```{r}
# Explore your gene of interest
GENE<-"DNAH10"

gene_counts_mask <- rna_genes$gene_name == GENE
gene_betas_mask <- cpg_sites$gene == GENE

# group masks: each one matches its own dataset's sample order
rna_met <- rna_clinical$met_status == "metastatic"
rna_nonmet <- rna_clinical$met_status == "non_metastatic"
meth_met <- methylation_clinical$metastatic
meth_nonmet <- !methylation_clinical$metastatic

rna_metastatic <- as.numeric(rna_counts[gene_counts_mask, rna_met])
rna_nonmetastatic <- as.numeric(rna_counts[gene_counts_mask, rna_nonmet])

# use betas_clean so the columns match methylation_clinical
methylation_metastatic <- betas_clean[gene_betas_mask, meth_met, drop = FALSE]
methylation_nonmetastatic <- betas_clean[gene_betas_mask, meth_nonmet, drop = FALSE]

#What are we doing here?
# We are subsetting the epigenomic and transcriptomic datasets by age group masks created earlier.

```

```{r}
# Transcriptional differences
boxplot(rna_nonmetastatic, rna_metastatic,
        names = c("Non-metastatic", "Metastatic"),
        xlab = "Group", ylab = "Counts", main = paste(GENE, "expression"),
        col = c("blue", "red"))
```

```{r}
# Show methylation differences at CpG sites in this gene 
# Methylation differences at each CpG site in this gene
n_cpg <- nrow(methylation_nonmetastatic)
plot(1:n_cpg, rowMeans(methylation_nonmetastatic), col = "blue", type = "h", lwd = 3,
     ylim = c(0, 1), ylab = "Average Beta", xlab = "CpG sites",
     main = paste(GENE, "methylation"))
lines((1:n_cpg) + 0.3, rowMeans(methylation_metastatic), col = "red", type = "h", lwd = 3)
legend("topright", legend = c("Non-metastatic", "Metastatic"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 3, cex = 0.7)
```
